author: New China TV
description: Unitree Robotics unveiled Monday a new humanoid robot, achieving a 2-meter standing high jump and a top speed of 12.66 m/s (45.6 km/h) with a leg length of 0.85 meters. The company says the machine has surpassed the standing high-jump and running-speed records of humans worldwide, after just over three months of development. With substantial room for further optimization, Unitree says the robot's performance could improve significantly in the months ahead.
title: Unitree unveils "Superman" humanoid robot

description: "August 15 is a day when we must reflect deeply on what Japan did." title: August 15, a day for Japan to deeply reflect on its wartime past

description:

#Afghanistan #Reconstruction #Economy #Development

author: New China TV
description: Once scarred by decades of quarrying, the mountains of Weihai in east China's Shandong Province have been transformed through more than 20 years of ecological restoration. Former mining sites have been turned into green landscapes and tourist attractions, creating jobs and new opportunities for local communities. The transformation highlights how restoring damaged ecosystems can also support rural development. #EcologicalRestoration #RuralDevelopment
title: China restores abandoned mines, revives rural communities
